Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Shivani Rajput, Advocate holding brief of Sri Shafat
Ullah Khan, learned counsel for the informant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No. 213 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station- Dubagga District Lucknow.
In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the sister of the informant was enticed away by the applicant.

Subsequently, in her statement under Section 161 CrPC, the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that they went to various places from Sitapur to Moradabad and from Moradabad Haider Raza vs State Of U.P. sentences.text: In her statement under Section 164 CrPC, the victim admitted going alongwith the applicant to Sitapur and thereafter going to Delhi and thereafter to Bareily, and physical relations were also formed.
Learned counsel for the applicant relies upon various letters showing the intimacy of the applicant with the victim.
The tentative age of the victim is 16 years, however, the process of adjudication of age as prescribed under Section 94 has not happened so far.
Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

Considering the material on record and the statements of the victim recorded under Sections 161 and 164 CrPC, a clear case for bail is made out, particularly when the applicant has no criminal history.
Therefore, I am of the view that the applicant, who is in jail since 01.04.2023, is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant Haider Raza be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 14.3.2024 Vipul  Haider Raza vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179419760/
